summary: Both round-1 low findings are fixed, and I found no regression. IMP-R1-01: the policy counts stay at 698 byte-preserved and five reconciled-navigation. Every ledger entry now has matches_source_bytes; exactly three are false (GPU README.md, docs/performance/README.md and history.md), which gives 700 identical and three different. Each reconciled entry records pre_import_sha256, source_delta_base_sha256 and a reconciliation_result. For read_staging.md and user_kernels.md the pre-import hash equals the delta-base hash (2e37278f… and ccbeaba7…), and the imported hash equals the source hash. The GPU README's two bases differ, so it was merged by hand. The two new pages record null bases, and the checker requires them to be absent at both revisions. The ledger contains pre_import_commit (12366915…, the task base), which the checker reads. The record README and validation-02 now give the 698/5 and 700/3 counts consistently. The supplied task-base-to-commit diff shows the three existing pages received navigation-only edits, which resolves my prior limitation about the unseen pre-import pages. IMP-R1-02: the checker now lives only at notes/pr_campaign_import_20261116/check_pr_import.py. Its docstring says it is source-checkout-only. The semicolon statements are split. No stale reference to the old scripts/performance/analysis path remains, and the README invocation is updated. The notes tree is excluded by conftest collect_ignore, Ruff, Hatch (exclude and negated artifacts), Meson exclude_directories and all five pre-commit rewrite/AST hooks, so the moved checker is not installed, linted, rewritten or collected. import-check-02.log matches validation-02 and the supplied evidence: 703 paths, 703 source blobs, 47 snapshots, 109 links. The unchanged archive, test and isolation results carry forward from the original validation.json. The validation-02 diff_scope states that these files did not change; I did not compare them by commit diff.
